m: *Grass* and *water drops* stretch on forever, and a lone *tombstone* fades into the mist: **boundless** and hazy.
A *kneeling man* lifts his chin toward the *sun*: he **raises** his head with pride.
A bitter *grass* that tastes like old medicine: **wormwood**.
A *bent knife* scrapes a *hide* and a *comb* drags across it, leaving it all **wrinkled**.
A *big man* holds up a *leaky pot* and **boasts** that it is the best pot in the world.
He leans on one *elbow*, casts a *fishing line*, keeps a *bent knife* ready for the catch: lazy, **carefree** days.
A whole *rice field* of food, eaten under the *moon*, all goes to one place: your **stomach**.
A *thousand ants* march into an open *mouth* and get licked up by the **tongue**.
A *comb* scrapes, *splashing water* rinses, and a *standing knife* **peels** the skin off the fruit.
A *standing person* swings his *cane* and struts with his nose in the air: **proud**.
A *helping hand* reaches into the *tent* and **picks up** a doll with a painted *mouth*.
Deep in a *cave*, past an *archway*, a *person* finds a hollow with a chirping *mouth* in it: a **nest**.
A *bent knife* flashes and your *eye* snaps wide: you **open your eyes**.
A *helping hand* ties a *ribbon* to the *sparrow*'s cage to **carry** it along.
*Trudging feet* climb the *hillside* to the old emperor's **tomb**.
The *swaddled baby* screws up his *mouth* and **snorts** at the cold bottle.
A *tree* grows fluffy balls like a *white dove*'s feathers, soft enough for a *towel*: **cotton**.
The *sun* shines on green *moss* with not a cloud in sight: a **clear** day.
*Gold coins* buy a little **bell** for the *teepee*; bump it with your *elbow* and it rings.
Shovel *soil* into the hole, mark it with a *cross*, and keep an *eye* on it until it is **filled**.
The farm *boss* sets a *side dish* out for the piglets every day: he **rears** them.
Under the hot *sun*, a *cloaked beggar* begs for a few *water drops*: he is **thirsty**.
Under the *blanket*, one *mouth* meets another: a **kiss**.
A *helping hand* draws the *curtains* and cuts a costume with a *knife*: time to **dress up**.

Under the *moon*, a *bowing man* taps the *cliff* edge with a *bent knife* and it snaps: **brittle**.
After climbing the *mountain*, his *mouth* gasps and sweat drips off his *beard*: he **pants**.
Throw a *fishing net* over the *little fortune stick*, the *sun* and the *cross*: a **cover** for them all.
A *pole* with a *drop* of ink beside it: the *fortune stick* used to **divine** the future.
A *campfire* behind a little iron *door*: the **stove**.
At the *stop sign*, he trades a *spoon* for a chopped-up *tree*: **firewood**.
A *standing heart* sits in a *tent* under the *moon*, a *standing knife* cutting cake: **pleased**.
A *frog* is tied up with *silk thread* twisted into a **rope**.

Cut *grass* from the *rice field* and tie it with *dark thread*: **store up** hay for winter.
An *eye* closes as the *cobra* coils up for the winter: **sleep**.

A *mouth* shouts across the *rice field*: hey, come and **feed** the chickens!
A *standing person* wears his shoes on his hands and grins: **silly**.
In the *grass*, under the *sun*, a *big man* hugs a *heart cushion* and gazes at his hero: he **admires** her.

A *woman* hides stolen shirts among her own on the *drying rack*: **crafty**.
A *door* covered in *feathers*, swinging back and forth: a giant **fan**.
Saw a *tree* into boards and nail them into an *open crate* with doors: a **cupboard**.

A *small speech bubble* cries out as the baby takes its first *long stride* into the world: **birth**.

*Water drops* puff up into a *blanket* of foam around a bathing *cobra*: **bubbles**.
A *left hand* snatches your *shell* coins while the other waves a *halberd*: a **thief**.
A small roof held up by posts as straight as a *nail*: a **pavilion** in the park.
A thin *dusk moon* peeks out as the sun goes down: **evening**.
*Father* comes home under one *dusk moon*, then the next *dusk moon*, every single evening: **dad**.
Pour from the *wine jug* for the friend who rowed you between the *islands*: **repay** him.
A *standing person* strokes his long *beard* as the *rain* falls, reading the old classics: a **Confucian scholar**.
A *woman* and a *big man* inside one *fence*: joined by **marriage**.

A *helping hand* rests its *elbow* on the *arrow* rack, standing **next to** the archer.
A *standing person* with a head shining like the *sun*: a shaven Buddhist **monk**.
Under the *roof* of the hive, bees fill the comb with sweet **honey**.
A *mouth* **chants** old poems while the *clock* ticks the rhythm.
A *prowling dog* meets a hairy beast munching a *seedling* in the *sun*: an **ape**.

A *prowling dog* and a *person* squeeze between *two planks* topped with *horns*: so **narrow**.
*Sprinkles* of paint and a pale *moon* face: the *portrait* **resembles** you.
Put *candy* on your *tongue*: **sweet**.

A *horse* covered in a *lattice* of dark spots: **dappled**.
A *shirt* for everyone in the *valley*, with plenty to spare: **abundant**.

A *helping hand* lifts the *child*, who stops his *yawn* to **pick** an apple.

Lead them on *dark thread* to graze the *rice field*: **livestock**.

A *helping hand* throws a *hide* over the shoulders: **drape** it.
A *cart* brings fresh soil to the *seedbed* to **assist** the plants.
An *elbow* pokes out of the *blanket* and crooks like a hook: it **attracts** a curious visitor.
Behind the *curtains*, a *knife* trims flowers into a wide *dish*: a **basin**.
*Three planks* lie between one *rice field* and the next *rice field*: the **border**.

Shape *soil* into a stag with *antlers* nibbling a *sprout* under the *moon*: **model** it in clay.

Just a *pinch* of a toddler's *mouth* and the whole room is **noisy**.
A bulging shape tied tight at the top and stuffed full: a **sack**.
A *big man* inside a *fence* nods, *mouth* closed, *heart* agreeing: **mm-hmm**.
A *white dove* floats on calm *water drops*: a still **lake**.

A *sheep* hides behind *two planks* when the shearing *knife* comes out: **shy**.

A *hanging lamp* with a *mouth*-shaped shade dangles from a *towel* hook: **hung up** high.

*Water drops* rise as tall as *wheat* and crash over the *thumb* on the rail: a **big wave**.
An old man leans on his *cane*, *heart* at ease, humming a song long and **drawn out**.
Two pairs of legs like *twins* under a crown of antlers: a **deer**.
A *standing person* reaches out a *claw* and grabs the enemy's *child*: **taken prisoner**.
